summary: Hiker with injured ankle near Willow Pass in the Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness (~12 mi SW of Aspen) could not continue; 27 MRA members mobilized, located him at 5:25pm, carried by wheeled litter ~1200 vertical ft to trailhead for ambulance to Aspen Valley Hospital.
location: near Willow Pass, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
notes: Source: Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page.
